content: 中华医典 is a comprehensive digital platform dedicated to preserving and disseminating the wisdom of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) through ancient medical classics.

Our platform brings together over 1,000 classical medical texts spanning more than two millennia of Chinese medical history, from the foundational texts of the pre-Qin period to the comprehensive works of the Ming and Qing dynasties.
With over 400 million characters of medical wisdom, our collection represents one of the most complete digital archives of Chinese medical classics available today.

We believe that these ancient medical treasures contain invaluable insights that remain relevant to modern healthcare and wellness practices, and our mission is to make this knowledge accessible to scholars, practitioners, and enthusiasts worldwide.

mission.content: Our mission is to preserve the heritage of Traditional Chinese Medicine by digitizing, organizing, and making accessible the complete corpus of classical medical texts. We strive to bridge ancient wisdom with modern technology, enabling global access to China's medical heritage while supporting academic research and clinical practice.

challenge.content: This platform represents our commitment to cultural preservation and knowledge dissemination. By leveraging modern digital technologies and AI-powered search capabilities, we aim to make these ancient texts more accessible and useful for contemporary research and education in Traditional Chinese Medicine.

header.subtitle: Comprehensive digital library of Chinese medical classics, featuring over 1,000 ancient texts with AI-powered search and academic research tools
